evals.prompt: Review this PR that adds a currency input component: [diff].
evals.expected_output: A review summary with verdict, checks run, labeled comments by priority including correctness of number parsing, accessibility of the input and test coverage.
expectations: States which checks were run and their result
Labels comments as Blocking, Should fix or Suggestion
Checks locale-aware number parsing and formatting
Checks the input has a label and error association
